irrigationStage1.title: 1st Irrigation (Crown Root / Early)
irrigationStage1.reason: Critical irrigation for crown root initiation and early plant establishment (10–15 days after sowing).

fertilizerStage1.title: 1st Fertilizer & Weeding
fertilizerStage1.reason: Top-dressing with Urea / NPK and weed control to promote vigorous root and shoot growth.

irrigationStage2.title: 2nd Irrigation (Tillering)
irrigationStage2.reason: Essential moisture required during active tillering and vegetative canopy expansion.

cropHealthStage.title: Crop Health & Pest Scouting
cropHealthStage.reason: Inspect crop foliage for stem borers, aphids, rust, or nutrient deficiency symptoms.

fertilizerStage2.title: 2nd Fertilizer (Booster / Foliar)
fertilizerStage2.reason: Foliar nutrient spray or micronutrient booster before flowering to support reproductive organs.

irrigationStage3.title: 3rd Irrigation (Flowering)
irrigationStage3.reason: Critical moisture stage during flowering and panicle / pod formation to prevent blossom drop.

irrigationStage4.title: 4th Irrigation (Grain Filling)
irrigationStage4.reason: Final irrigation ensuring plump grain and pod development without moisture stress.

step1.title: Start by setting up your farm
step1.description: Tap on your Profile icon to manage your farm, settings and more.

step2.title: Go to "My Farm"
step2.description: Tap on "My Farm" to register your land and access all your farm information.

step3.title: Register your land
step3.description: Tap "Register Land" to start adding your field and access personalized insights.

step4.title: Register your field
step4.description: Choose how you want to register your land — mark the boundary on the map or walk around your field using GPS.
step4.registeredDesc: Choose to register your land by Marking on Map or Walking around your field. Your land is now registered!
step4.successDescription: Your field boundary has been saved. You can now view and analyse your field.

step5.title: Field Analysis
step5.description: Get complete insights about your field — soil moisture, texture, weather and advanced radar data.

step6.title: Marketplace
step6.description: Find the best market prices, compare trends and get the most value for your crops.
